file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) Windows console executable (MinGW-w64 GCC 13, stripped)

injection_details.method: Reflective DLL loader (in-process manual PE mapping). Decrypted image is mapped into a VirtualAlloc'd RWX buffer, section-mapped, relocations fixed, imports resolved, then its DllMain export is invoked directly.
injection_details.target_process: Self (current process) — no remote process injection; no CreateRemoteThread/WriteProcessMemory/OpenProcess present
injection_details.target_discovery: N/A (no external target located; embedded payload loaded into own address space)
injection_details.payload_write: VirtualAlloc(NULL/preferred ImageBase, SizeOfImage, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE (0x3000), PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40)); memcpy SizeOfHeaders; per-section mapping (VirtualAddress + raw size); fix IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 (type 0xA) relocations via BaseRelocationDirectory; resolve imports with LoadLibraryA + GetProcAddress (ImportDirectory); search export table for 'DllMain' and call DllMain(base, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH=1, NULL); then Sleep(2000).
injection_details.entry_call: Entry 0x1410 -> CRT startup 0x1190 -> main 0x140002f30 -> tail-jump (jmp 0x1bd6) into payload runner 0x140001bd5

encryption_details.algorithm: Custom 16-byte block cipher, 10 rounds: for each round i (0..9) and byte j (0..15): out[j] = AES_SBOX[in[j]] XOR key[j] XOR (27 * i). Uses the standard 256-byte AES forward S-box stored at RVA 0x5000 (.rdata). 32-byte encrypted blob processed as two 16-byte blocks.
encryption_details.key_storage: Plaintext ASCII in .rdata at RVA 0x5100; the key string's trailing 'DllMain' (0x5110) is also used as the export-name string the reflective loader strcmp()s against

decoded_strings.decrypted_payload: 32-byte blob at .data RVA 0x4000 decrypts to non-PE, non-printable bytes (0xCD 0xF5 0x9F 0x42 0xF3 ...) - placeholder/dummy payload that would fail the loader's MZ check

anti_analysis: peb_antidebug: BeingDebugged flag read via TEB->PEB (gs:[0x60]) + byte at PEB+2; if debugged, payload is NOT decrypted/loaded (function 0x140001bd5 returns early)
encrypted_payload: embedded 32-byte PE stub encrypted with custom S-box cipher
tls_callbacks: MinGW-w64 CRT TLS callbacks present (run before entry point)
executable memory: VirtualAlloc with PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE for mapped image
